purpose: Define explicit sets of quality rules, execution scope, severity, thresholds and gating policy for a particular DWH workflow or data boundary.

topics.name: DWH Quality Validation Profile
topics.purpose: Define explicit sets of quality rules, execution scope, severity, thresholds and gating policy for a particular DWH workflow or data boundary.

semantics.profile_rule: Validation profile has an explicit identity and exact member quality-rule refs.
semantics.threshold_rule: Aggregate pass/fail thresholds are explicit where used.
semantics.gate_rule: Whether a failed quality check blocks import/write/materialization/export/other workflow is explicit per profile.
semantics.execution_rule: Validation execution identity is distinct from profile identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Profile gating affects workflow acceptance only and does not create source authorization.
semantics.order_rule: Rule execution order is non-semantic unless dependencies are explicitly declared.

invariants.rule: Data-quality rules and results produce explicit evidence about exact data/schema identities; they never silently rewrite source data, change semantic ownership, declassify content or become authorization decisions.

hard_gates.condition: unknown quality state treated as pass
profile execution identity reused as profile definition identity
profile scope inferred from current UI context

references.purpose: Profiles may gate exact write workflows.
